text:
alex: Quick heads-up: planning runtime 2.18 rollforward tonight 22:00 UTC. Contains kernel reorder + kv-cache pointer fix. Need pin/unpin call for embed-heavy models.

sam: Are we requiring SDK 3.5.0 for the new routing header? If yes, call it out in notes.

meera: Canary results: eu-west canary shows stable 99.9% success but p95 up ~6% for llama3q quant with kv enabled. No OOMs.

nick: Suggest we soft-pin embed-models/* -> 2.17 for 4 hours post-roll to avoid transient token costs. Text-gen groups can go to 2.18.

ops-oncall: Set revert policy now: deadman at 01:00 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx rate >1.5% or p95 > +25% sustained 10m.

deploybot: Automated: snapshotting pinlist at 21:30 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.17 -> models: [core-chat/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.18 -> models: [experimental-parrot/*]
+ soft_pin: embed-models/* -> runtime:2.17 until 02:00 UTC
```

alex: Decision: apply soft_pin for embed-models/* only. Action items:
- meera: paste canary repro + minimal prompts by 21:45.
- sam: update release notes with SDK 3.5.0 fallback config by 21:50.
- deploybot: apply soft_pin at 21:30 and publish to /releases/2.18/pins.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 01:00 UTC and page leads if triggered.

meera: Repro snippet: `prompt = "condense long meeting notes into bullets"` — first-token delay visible at small batches. I'll attach traces in the PR.

sam: Add this to notes for fallback:
```
client:
  runtime_preference: ["2.18","2.17"]  # SDK 3.5.0 supports graceful fallback
```

nick: I'll loop in CS for customers who explicitly requested embedding stability; DMing now.

ops-oncall: Implemented revert policy: thresholds set, notification channel #release-ops, will page if tripped.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin applied at 21:30 UTC. Pin diff published. Rollforward scheduled 22:00 UTC.

alex: If anyone sees generation regressions in canary, post here and tag me. We'll hold any further unpins until 06:00 UTC.

meera: Follow-up: traced a hotspot in kv_refresh() at batch_size=1; not blocking but filing follow-up task.

sam: Pushing SDK changelog and quick rollback snippet once CI passes.

deploybot: Automated: rollforward started 22:00 UTC. Will update on success/failure.

ops-oncall: Post-rollcheck at 22:40 UTC in #release-ops. I'll run smoke traffic for embed pipelines.

alex: Thanks all. Closing thread for now ":thumbsup:"
